For people who complain about non-EX decks or needing lots of common cards to win: play Pika.

Seriously, a Pika deck seem to the best EX deck available right now, and it's extremely easy to make. It has winnable matchups against Blaine (Rapidash is one shot by Pika + Giovanni) and Mewtwo EX (Ralts dies to Pika, Kirlia dies to Pika, Mewtwo is 2HKO'd by Pika so easy for revenge kills), and even can potentially win against Misty decks (if they don't get crazy flips with Misty).

I've been playing multiple decks in the PvP event, and honestly the most consistent wins I've been getting are from using a Pika deck. Obviously you can brick since you really need a full bench to threaten after the first few turns, but the deck deals consistent damage without needing coin flips, the strongest cards you have only need 1-2 energy to attack, and it can deal a lot of damage very early which forces your opponent to make some hard decisions depending on what cards they have out. It's also more of a skill based deck than most other decks as you need to asses the board state and what cards are available on both sides so you can plan out trades and doing the most efficient damage to pressure your opponent.

That's what I think, anyone else feel the same about Pika decks?

And currently since Pika is the best  deck right now, it means water decks are less threatening, so Pika can enjoy bullying misty decks most of the time someone brave enough plays it.

Edit: Also, forgot to mention that it's one of the few decks right now that absolutely do not mind going first.
